drafter.private_reasoning: The client's settlement floor is confidential and must not appear in the redline, cover note, or document metadata. Propose an opening purchase price above that floor and seller-protective qualifications to the representations and indemnity, while keeping the timing workable. Scrub internal comments and metadata before sending.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is our proposed first-round revision. We have proposed a cash purchase price and added customary qualifications and limits to the seller’s representations and indemnity. We are open to discussing the price and related mechanics, as well as a practical closing timetable, on our next call.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 9,500,000 in cash by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller. The Purchase Price shall be subject only to adjustments expressly agreed in writing by the parties.
edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing, or on such other date as the parties may agree in writing. Each party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy its closing obligations promptly.
edits.name: Closing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that, to the Seller’s knowledge, the financial statements delivered to the Buyer have been prepared in accordance with the accounting principles consistently applied by the Seller and are accurate in all material respects as of their stated dates, subject to any qualifications or disclosures set forth in the applicable disclosure schedules.
edits.name: Representations

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations in this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against direct losses arising from undisclosed liabilities for which the Seller is responsible under this Agreement. The Seller shall have no indemnification obligation unless aggregate claims exceed USD 100,000, and the Seller’s aggregate liability shall not exceed 10% of the Purchase Price. No claim may be brought more than twelve months after Closing, except for claims based on fraud.
edits.name: Indemnity

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note disclose no confidential settlement floor or exact confidential figure. The stated USD 9,500,000 purchase price is not the confidential minimum. No hidden-content categories are indicated for removal.

receiver.message_back: Our client appreciates the all-cash structure, but cannot accept the USD 9.5 million price alongside the proposed representations and indemnity; any agreement must pair a materially improved price with tighter seller protections, including a lower aggregate cap, a deductible basket, and appropriately limited claim scope and survival. We are prepared to discuss those points and a practical closing timetable on the next call.

drafter.private_reasoning: Offer a meaningful but controlled price reduction and strengthen seller protections in response to opposing counsel. Preserve the existing 12-month survival period and fraud carveout, make the basket expressly deductible, reduce the cap, and limit indemnity claims to direct, actually incurred losses. Do not disclose the client's confidential settlement floor.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. To move the discussion forward, our client is prepared to reduce the cash purchase price to USD 9,000,000, with a USD 100,000 deductible basket, a 5% aggregate cap, and indemnity limited to direct losses actually incurred and arising from the matters specified in the agreement. The proposed 12-month claim period and fraud exception would remain. We are also open to confirming a practical closing timetable on the next call; the current 30-day period is a workable starting point. These points are subject to documentation and agreement on the remaining terms.

receiver.message_back: Our client can proceed at USD 9,000,000 if indemnity covers breaches of the representations, warranties and covenants as well as undisclosed liabilities, with a USD 50,000 tipping basket, a 15% aggregate cap, and a 24-month claim period (fraud remaining uncapped); otherwise, the price must be reduced to USD 8,500,000.
